checks.text: The page displays the heading "UUID Generator" and the text "No IDs generated yet" in the history section.

Selecting "v4" in the dropdown labelled "Version" and clicking the button "Generate" adds a list item in the history section containing a 36-character string matching the pattern `[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}`; the text "No IDs generated yet" is removed.

Selecting "v1" in the dropdown labelled "Version" and clicking the button "Generate" adds a list item containing a 36-character string where the 13th character (version digit) is "1" and the 17th character (variant digit) is one of "8", "9", "a", or "b".
Entering "5" in the field labelled "Batch size" and clicking the button "Generate" adds exactly 5 new list items to the history section, each with a unique 36-character UUID.

Clicking the button "Copy all" copies the text of all current history items to the clipboard, separated by newlines, and the button label changes to "Copied" for 2 seconds before reverting to "Copy all".
Clicking the button "Clear history" removes all list items from the history section and displays the text "No IDs generated yet".
Selecting "v4" in the dropdown labelled "Version", clicking "Generate" to add one item, then reloading the page still shows that same UUID string in the history section.

After generating one v4 UUID, clicking the button "Delete <first 8 chars of UUID>" removes that specific item from the history section; if it was the only item, the text "No IDs generated yet" reappears.
